1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutSegments
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutRetraction
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronJunctions
4 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.RegularCutTree
5 
6 /-! The actual cut locus is a finite tree, without choosing a canonical
7 polyhedron graph. Every junction and original cut vertex is marked, so an
8 open tree edge contains exactly two shortest routes to each of its points. -/
9 
10 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
11 
12 open Set
13 
14 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
15   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
16     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
17 
18 include size small_faces in
19 /-- Every exact embedded graph of the actual cut set is a tree. -/
20 theorem small_embedded_cut_graph_isTree (a : frontier P.body)
21     (K : P.EmbeddedCutGraph a) : K.graph.IsTree := by
22   letI : ContractibleSpace (P.cutSetInSpace a) :=
23     small_cutSetInSpace_contractible size small_faces a
24   exact ⟨K.connected_of_trace_connected (isConnected_iff_connectedSpace.mpr inferInstance),
25     K.acyclic_of_contractible_trace⟩
26 
27 include size small_faces in
28 /-- The actual finite cut tree, subdivided at every junction and original cut vertex. -/
29 theorem small_exists_regular_cut_tree (a : frontier P.body) : Nonempty (P.CutLocusTree a) := by
30   let marks : Set Space := Subtype.val '' P.cutExceptions a
31   have finite_marks : marks.Finite := (small_cutExceptions_finite size small_faces a).image Subtype.val
32   have marks_cut : marks ⊆ P.cutSetInSpace a := by
33     rintro _ ⟨b, exceptional, rfl⟩
34     exact ⟨b, P.cutExceptions_subset_cutSet a exceptional, rfl⟩
35   obtain ⟨K, contains⟩ := small_exists_cut_graph_containing size small_faces a marks finite_marks marks_cut
36   exact ⟨{
37     toEmbeddedCutGraph := K
38     tree := small_embedded_cut_graph_isTree size small_faces a K
39     exceptional_vertices := fun b exceptional => contains ⟨b, exceptional, rfl⟩ }⟩
40 
41 include size small_faces in
42 /-- Every open tree edge consists of targets with exactly two shortest routes. -/
43 theorem small_cut_tree_open_edge_two_routes (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
44     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (b : frontier P.body)
45     (inside : (b : Space) ∈ openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space)) :
46     Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) = 2 := by
47   have cut := T.open_edge_cut edge b inside
48   have regular := T.open_edge_regular edge b inside
49   have different : a ≠ b := by
50     rintro rfl
51     exact P.source_not_cutSet a cut
52   have not_vertex : (b : Space) ∉ P.vertices :=
53     fun vertex => regular (Or.inr ⟨vertex, different.symm⟩)
54   have multiple : (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a :=
55     cut.resolve_right (fun h => not_vertex h.1)
56   have not_unique := ((P.multiple_routes_iff_fiber a b).mp multiple).2
57   have lower : ¬ (P.geodesicFiber a b).ncard ≤ 1 := by
58     intro bound
59     exact not_unique ((ncard_le_one (small_geodesicFiber_finite size small_faces a b different)).mp bound)
60   have upper : ¬ 2 < Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) := fun many =>
61     regular (Or.inl ((small_junction_iff_route_count size small_faces a b different).mpr many))
62   change ¬ Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) ≤ 1 at lower
63   omega
64 
65 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
